Name: Jerushah, Daughter of Zadok
Summary: Jerushah, daughter of Zadok, was the mother of Jotham, who was twenty-five when he began to reign sixteen years.
KeyStory: Jotham's mother's name was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
RelatedPeople: Jotham, King of Judah; Zadok, Father of Jerushah
LifeLesson: A mother's name opens the record of a righteous reign.
